cards.title: Sparse Sampling NCA Methodology and Output Structure
cards.claim: When the Sparse Sampling option is enabled in Phoenix NCA, the engine computes mean concentration or rate at each unique time value/interval across subjects. It estimates standard parameters plus specific standard errors (SE_Cmax, SE_AUClast, SE_AUCall for plasma; SE_Max_Rate, SE_AURC_last, SE_AURC_all for urine). Output worksheets are renamed to 'Mean Curve Final Parameters' and 'Mean Curve Summary Table' to indicate group-level estimands.
conditions: Applicable to pre-clinical sparse sampling designs.
Requires loading an NCA model with the Sparse Sampling option enabled.
Data is treated as a special case of plasma or urine concentration data.
required_inputs: Concentration or rate data with subject IDs and time points.
Configuration of NCA model with Sparse Sampling option active.
limitations: Outputs represent group-level means, not individual trajectories.
Standard errors are derived from the mean curve structure, not individual variability directly.
cards.downstream_use: Use for analyzing pre-clinical PK studies where individual full profiles are not available. Interpret parameters as mean curve estimates with associated uncertainty metrics.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
